name: Mr. Bean Waiting
look: Four panels in a 2x2 grid under an empty black band. Mr. Bean (Rowan Atkinson), in a brown tweed jacket and red tie, waits beside a field of yellow flowers: hands on hips, checking his watch, sitting on the grass, then lying flat on the ground.
use: Shows waiting so long that impatience turns into giving up completely. The caption in the black band names whatever is taking forever, like a late reply, a slow download or a promised sequel.
slots: the black band at the top: what you are waiting for
examples: Me waiting for my friend who texted "five minutes away" an hour ago
Waiting for the game to finish its day-one update
describe: mr bean in a yellow flower field checking his watch
rowan atkinson getting bored and lying down in a field
man waits so long he sits down then lies on the ground
four panel of a guy in a tweed jacket waiting forever
british comedian impatient by the road then gives up
origin: Rowan Atkinson as his character Mr. Bean, waiting beside a field of yellow flowers.
